title: Mario Tennis: Power Tour
subtitle: A tennis career has a place between matches
summary: Mario Tennis: Power Tour is Camelot's Game Boy Advance sports role-playing game following young players through the development of a tennis career. Known in Europe as Mario Power Tennis, it combines singles and doubles matches with a story-led structure and a growing set of abilities. The handheld adventure gives the player a competitor to develop rather than only a familiar character to select. Practice and progress lead toward more demanding opponents, making the next match a test of both the player's timing and the capabilities accumulated by the tennis player taking the court.
body: Mario Tennis: Power Tour is Camelot's Game Boy Advance sports role-playing game following young players through the development of a tennis career. Known in Europe as Mario Power Tennis, it combines singles and doubles matches with a story-led structure and a growing set of abilities. The handheld adventure gives the player a competitor to develop rather than only a familiar character to select. Practice and progress lead toward more demanding opponents, making the next match a test of both the player's timing and the capabilities accumulated by the tennis player taking the court.

Topspin, slice and other familiar strokes provide ways to alter a rally, while Power Shots introduce more dramatic offensive and defensive responses. An attacking special can make the return difficult through its force or secondary effect. A defensive one can help reach a ball or counter the extra trouble created by an opponent's power. Choosing when to use an available ability therefore matters alongside ordinary positioning. The rally remains readable as tennis, but the special actions give it additional turning points when a well-timed response can recover a seemingly lost exchange.

The campaign's sporting progress extends into doubles, where covering the court and coordinating with a partner change the demands of a point. Character development gives the continuing journey a practical result, adding another layer to the choice of stroke or special action. Power Tour follows Camelot's earlier handheld approach to Mario sports, allowing a school-style career and a more fantastic tennis world to share one structure. A particular opponent can become a milestone because reaching that match reflects the training, earlier contests and new abilities that have made the player ready to face it.

The next return can change the rally
